title: Select Same Type (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Select Same Type applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Select Same Type (BtnSelectSameType) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Select Same Type selection scope matches its metadata contract
scenarios.expected: Select Same Type (BtnSelectSameType, MinSelection=1, RequiredType=Shapes) is at 1 selected shape(s) and above and refused below that, refused for an empty selection and for a slide selection. The scenario asserts that the feature's declared [FeatureMetadata] scope drives the production sidebar enablement decision consistently (metadata -> SidebarStateEvaluator, the declared minimum reachable as an enabled button). It does not execute or inspect the command's own selection guard: an enabled command can still refuse a selection, which is why the guard and the PowerPoint effect stay owned by the office-automated leg.

scenarios.title: Select Same Type extends the selection to the matching shapes in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Select Same Type after selecting one of two rectangles (with a distractor oval on the slide) extends the active selection to exactly the two rectangles and excludes the oval, the feature reports execution, the slide shape count is unchanged, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.
